title: My Pet's Day
description: Practise present and past simple, and write about a day in the life of a pet.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.text: 🐶 My dog ___ up at seven o'clock.
exercises.explanation: Add -s with he, she and it: the dog gets up.
Add -s with he, she and it: Max eats.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My cat sleeps on my bed.
exercises.explanation: Subject + verb + place: My cat sleeps on my bed.

exercises.text: Yesterday my dog ___ in the park.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
answers: My cat does not like water.
exercises.explanation: Use "doesn't" with he, she and it.

exercises.text: I ___ take my dog for a walk every day.
exercises.explanation: Use "have to" or "must" for things you need to do.

exercises.text: 🐟 My fish is the ___ pet in our house.
exercises.explanation: Use "the quietest" to compare many pets.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We play with a ball in the garden.
In the garden we play with a ball.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Yesterday Coco drinked all the milk.
answers: Yesterday Coco drank all the milk.

exercises.text: My puppy ___ a big bone yesterday.
The bird is ___ on the tree now. (sing)

exercises.explanation: "Fast" is an adverb too: runs fast.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My dog goes to bed at nine o'clock.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My hamster is more cute than your cat.
answers: My hamster is cuter than your cat.

exercises.text: 🛁 Lucy ___ her cat a bath last Sunday. (give)

task.prompt: Write about your pet's day. If you have no pet, write about a pet you like.
contentPoints: Say what your pet is and its name.
Say what it does in the morning.
Say what it likes to eat.
task.modelAnswer: My pet is a dog. His name is Max. He gets up at seven o'clock and eats his breakfast. He likes to play with a ball. Yesterday he ran in the park and found a big stick. I love Max because he is kind.
